item.title: Almelo man sentenced to 120 days for staging his own death
item.description: A 31-year-old man from Almelo was sentenced to 120 days in prison, including 103 days suspended, for attempting to stage his own death and threatening public officials.

item.title: Food bank use in Netherlands jumps 7.5% to 155,600 amid rising cost of living
item.description: The number of people using food banks in the Netherlands rose last year to 155,600, up from 144,750 in 2024, an increase of about 7.5 percent. A year earlier, usage had declined.

item.title: Dutch border control catch graverobbers with urns, ornaments stolen from German cemetery
item.description: The Limburg Koninklijke Marechaussee’s cross-border team caught a pair of graverobbers when checking a German vehicle on the A67 near Venlo on Saturday morning.

item.title: 33,000 drivers caught violating Dutch railway crossings in two years
item.description: Between February 2024 and early 2026, 33,000 drivers committed traffic violations at railway crossings in the Netherlands, according to ProRail, the country’s railway infrastructure manager.

item.title: Safe stolen from home in Belgium found 14 years later in Netherlands
item.description: A safe stolen from a home in Belgium 14 years ago was discovered Saturday in a waterway between Middelburg and Oost-Souburg and has been returned to its owner.

item.title: Dutch police threaten to publicly humiliate 100 scammers & fake cops still at large
item.description: The police have launched a campaign to “turn the tide” in the skyrocketing number of fake cop and fake helpdesk scams.

item.title: Half of trauma patients never fully recover, expert says
item.description: Patients who survive serious accidents face long-term challenges that go beyond physical recovery, according to Mariska de Jongh, newly appointed professor of Acute Care from a Patient Perspective

item.title: Dutch cities to get 7 million euros to raise vaccinations in low-income areas
item.description: Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, and Utrecht will receive a total of 7 million euros in 2026 to increase vaccination rates in low-income neighborhoods, the Dutch government announced.

item.title: 62% of children and teens feel unheard by their municipalities
item.description: A UNICEF Netherlands survey of over 1,000 children shows that 62 percent of kids and teenagers between the ages of 10 and 18 feel their municipalities don’t care about their opinions.
